name: End Of The World
overview: The Bible reveals that the end of the world is marked by the coming day of the Lord, characterized by His righteous wrath against sinners and a time of great tribulation (Isaiah 13:9; Zechariah 14:1). Jesus teaches that many will falsely claim His identity, deceiving many, and that cosmic disturbances will follow this period of tribulation (Matthew 24:5, 24:29). Importantly, the exact timing of this day is known only by the Father, underscoring the need for watchfulness and faithfulness among believers (Matthew 24:36).
